note: Separate BlueMap maps of other bases. Kept out of the main map (world) on purpose. npm run map:bases writes their configs on the server. Y is ground level; the viewer opens slightly above it. "bluemap" holds a base's own drawing settings, set on top of the main map's (scripts/bluemap-conf.mjs): Joðville's mountains stand far above the main map's cave cut-off, so its caves are cut everywhere, as BlueMap's wiki suggests (10000); the surface is kept by cave-detection-ocean-floor and lit builds by cave-detection-uses-block-light.
